messages.Sales panel for WooCommerce store, custo: Sales panel for WooCommerce store, customers, sales reports, Money Order/EFT with receipt upload, simple payment page, free shipping bar, Google Merchant product feed and WhatsApp/email notifications.
messages.Renewal order #%1$s is waiting for payme: Renewal order #%1$s is waiting for payment: %2$s
messages.Turn off renewal? The subscription stays: Turn off renewal? The subscription stays valid until the end of the current period.
messages.Renewal is off. Your subscription stays: Renewal is off. Your subscription stays valid until %s.
messages.Sold as a monthly or yearly subscription: Sold as a monthly or yearly subscription (Flux Commerce). Renewals arrive as orders.
messages.Renews automatically; we send a reminder: Renews automatically; we send a reminder before every renewal. You can cancel any time from My account.
This product is not a subscription.
messages.The product could not be added to the ca: The product could not be added to the cart.
messages.Subscription #%d created; it starts when: Subscription #%d created; it starts when the payment arrives.
messages.Subscription ended; the renewal order is: Subscription ended; the renewal order is no longer needed.
messages.Only an active subscription can be renew: Only an active subscription can be renewed.
messages.A renewal order for this period was alre: A renewal order for this period was already created.
messages.Goes to the customer when the renewal or: Goes to the customer when the renewal order is created and again on the last day if it is unpaid.
messages.Goes to the customer when a subscription: Goes to the customer when a subscription ends.
messages.Hello {ad}, your {urun} subscription has: Hello {ad}, your {urun} subscription has ended. You can start it again at any time.
messages.Hello %1$s, your %2$s subscription has e: Hello %1$s, your %2$s subscription has ended. You can start it again at any time: %3$s
messages.Hello %1$s, your %2$s subscription (%3$s: Hello %1$s, your %2$s subscription (%3$s) renews on %4$s. Amount: %5$s. Pay here: %6$s
messages.The renewal job has not run for more tha: The renewal job has not run for more than 6 hours. Check the server cron (wp-cron.php); renewal orders and reminders wait until it runs.
messages.Dashboard, checkout, bank transfer, subs: Dashboard, checkout, bank transfer, subscriptions, product feed and notifications.
messages.Tick \"Subscription\" on a simple produc: Tick "Subscription" on a simple product and enter a monthly and/or yearly price. Renewals are paid by bank transfer or through the payment link; automatic card charging comes later.
messages.Create the renewal order (days before th: Create the renewal order (days before the period ends)
messages.The customer gets the reminder e-mail wi: The customer gets the reminder e-mail with the bank details or payment link at the same time, and once more on the last day if unpaid.
messages.Grace period after the period ends (days: Grace period after the period ends (days)
messages.Access stays on while the renewal is unp: Access stays on while the renewal is unpaid; after this the subscription ends. 0 = ends on the last day.
messages.Monthly and yearly payments. Renewal ord: Monthly and yearly payments. Renewal orders are created before each period ends; the customer pays by bank transfer or through the payment link.
messages.Renewal order created and the customer w: Renewal order created and the customer was notified.
messages.Renewal turned off; the subscription sta: Renewal turned off; the subscription stays valid until the end of the period.
messages.No subscriptions yet. Tick \"Subscriptio: No subscriptions yet. Tick "Subscription" on a simple product and give it a monthly or yearly price.
messages.End this subscription now? Access closes: End this subscription now? Access closes immediately.
messages.Not shown in the shop, search or sitemap: Not shown in the shop, search or sitemap; customers cannot open the product page. Sold only through a link (e.g. a pricing page). Only editors see the product page.
messages.Hidden product: only editors see this pa: Hidden product: only editors see this page. Customers buy it through a link.
messages.Where a customer goes when opening a hid: Where a customer goes when opening a hidden product page (e.g. your pricing page). Empty = home page.
messages.%1$s will be charged to your card on %2$: %1$s will be charged to your card on %2$s.
messages.Remove the card? Renewals will then be p: Remove the card? Renewals will then be paid with the payment link we e-mail you.
messages.The customer removed the stored card; th: The customer removed the stored card; this renewal is paid with the payment link.
messages.The card was removed. We will e-mail you: The card was removed. We will e-mail you a payment link before each renewal.
messages.Card stored for automatic subscription r: Card stored for automatic subscription renewals: %s.
messages.Subscription renewal charged to the stor: Subscription renewal charged to the stored card (%1$s), transaction %2$s.

messages.Automatic card charge failed: %1$s. Retr: Automatic card charge failed: %1$s. Retrying in %2$d day(s).
messages.Goes to the customer before a renewal th: Goes to the customer before a renewal that will be charged to the stored card.
messages.Your {urun} subscription ({donem}) renew: Your {urun} subscription ({donem}) renews on {bitis}. {tutar} will be charged to your card {kart}; you do not need to do anything.
messages.To change the card or turn off renewal,: To change the card or turn off renewal, go to My account › Subscriptions.
messages.Goes to the customer when the stored car: Goes to the customer when the stored card could not be charged after the last attempt.
messages.We could not renew your {urun} subscript: We could not renew your {urun} subscription
messages.We could not charge {tutar} to your card: We could not charge {tutar} to your card {kart} for your {urun} subscription. Please pay with the button below so the subscription continues.
messages.Hello %1$s, your %2$s subscription renew: Hello %1$s, your %2$s subscription renews on %3$s. %4$s will be charged to your card %5$s; you do not need to do anything. Manage it here: %6$s
messages.We could not renew your %s subscription: We could not renew your %s subscription
messages.Hello %1$s, we could not charge %2$s to: Hello %1$s, we could not charge %2$s to your card %3$s for your %4$s subscription. Please pay here so it continues: %5$s
messages.Tick \"Subscription\" on a simple produc: Tick "Subscription" on a simple product and enter a monthly and/or yearly price. If the first payment is made with a card provider that can store cards, renewals are charged to that card automatically; otherwise they are paid by bank transfer or through the payment link.
messages.no card provider yet (Flux Donate iyzico: no card provider yet (Flux Donate iyzico adds one).
messages.Monthly and yearly payments. Renewal ord: Monthly and yearly payments. Renewal orders are created before each period ends; a stored card is charged automatically, otherwise the customer pays by bank transfer or through the payment link.
